messages.subject: Guest contribution idea
messages.body: Hello, we would like to propose a guest article on healthcare market research.

messages.subject: Re: Guest contribution idea
messages.body: We charge an editorial fee of $250 per post. Would you consider a link exchange instead?

messages.subject: Re: Guest contribution idea
messages.body: Thanks. We would prefer an unpaid editorial contribution. Could we discuss terms?

messages.subject: Re: Guest contribution idea
messages.body: We can publish a sponsored post for $300. Please confirm today.
